name: Fix discount and shipping rounding
instruction: Fix quote() for the current billing rules. Inspect the repository, implement the correction, and run the available tests. Do not change tests to hide failures.

files.README.md: Billing migration. Current rules are in docs/contract.md. Run python -m unittest discover -s tests.
